summary: More password lookup parameters: ident (2.12) for the bcrypt version, length (default 20), and seed (2.12) for reproducible passwords.
questions: What is the default length of generated passwords?
How do I get the same random password every run?
How do I choose the bcrypt variant like 2b?

answer_card.title: password lookup length, seed, ident
answer_card.answer_md:
- `length` (default **20**)
- `seed` (2.12+): identical seeds yield identical passwords; a weak seed isn't secure
- `ident` (2.12+): bcrypt version (`2`, `2a`, `2y`, `2b`) when `encrypt=bcrypt`; ignored otherwise
